evaluation: Independent AI review, variant labels and repair status hidden in packet; not human ratings
limitations: Two new Korean personas and four prompts each, one pass per system: sixteen calls. Limited aggregate-upgrade pilot, not production reliability or a broad model ranking.

Inputs are fixed before this run. Prior development evidence and limited independent audits of older blind samples informed known failures. No outputs for this new plan were read. Adaptive research is not an externally secret benchmark.

Core model, persona compilation, native schema and visible reply composition change together. No demonstrations are used. This cannot identify isolated v8 effect, same-model improvement or LangGraph/Pi superiority.

Candidate generates multiple text parts, which the renderer joins with blank lines. This is transparent composition of model text, not a claim that one plain reply string was generated. Formatting may partially reveal the condition to a reviewer.

Identity or acknowledgement field names do not ensure useful contents. Judge full visible text, including contradictions across parts, unnecessary repetition, empty requested information and unsupported capability claims.
Equal output limits do not equalize input tokens, schema overhead, reply space or cost. All actual usage must be recorded; cost remains unknown unless supported by a current applicable price source.
Counterbalanced sequential order reduces one timing bias but does not eliminate provider nondeterminism. Seed is unspecified.
Memory correction and fresh-worker restart remove prior conversation equally. This is approved scoped-memory recovery, not continuous long-context retention.
Any invalid output or nondelivery fails full coverage; do not replace failed attempts with repaired or selected outputs.
The implementer may read the plan for integration but may not hard-code scored facts, expected answers or scenario-specific reply templates into the schema, renderer or guards.

The previous upgrade improved several sufficient counts but did not increase personality (5→5) and failed its full gate. All failed controlled and same-model results remain preserved; this new test does not redefine their outcomes.

Mixed -답니다/-랍니다 versus strict 해요체 had earlier interpretive ambiguity. This plan prospectively fixes those forms as partial1 when mixed into otherwise 해요체 narration, identically for both conditions. Earlier reviews are not revised.
